sloka: स तस्य वेगं च कपेर्महात्मनः पराक्रमं चारिषु पार्थिवात्मजः ।विधारयन् स्वं च बलं महाबलो हिमक्षये सूर्य इवाभिवर्धते ।। ५.४७.९।।।।
transliteration: sa tasya vegaṁ ca kapermahātmanaḥ parākramaṁ cāriṣu pārthivātmajaḥ ।vidhārayan svaṁ ca balaṁ mahābalo himakṣaye sūrya ivābhivardhate ।। 5.47.9।।।।

translations.english: Aksha, the mighty prince judging the speed and prowess of the monkey with his own in confronting enemies and the strength of the monkey, began to swell up in spirit like the glow of the Sun at the end of winter.
